title: GapNoiseConstrainedGeneralizedMonotone.lean

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Constrained monotone variational inequality: find x* ∈ X with ⟨F(x*),w−x*⟩ ≥ 0 for every w ∈ X. X is convex, F is continuous and globally monotone; no objective function or saddle representation is assumed. A solution satisfies ‖x0−x*‖ ≤ R and ‖F(x*)‖ ≤ G.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Separately counted exact Euclidean projection onto X, characterized by proj(z) ∈ X and ⟨z−proj(z),w−proj(z)⟩ ≤ 0 for every w ∈ X.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Unbiased stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ω), valid on X, with independent identically distributed seeds. The oracle supplies operator values, not necessarily gradients.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x,y,M, a bound ‖F(x+θ(y−x))‖ ≤ M along the entire segment implies ‖F(x)−F(y)‖ ≤ (L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension-dependent restriction or bounded diameter of X is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Gap-dependent second moment: E‖g(x,ω)−F(x)‖² ≤ σ²+v⟨F(x)−F(x*),x−x*⟩ on X, with σ,v ≥ 0. No uniform variance bound or exponential-tail assumption is imposed. All parameters, including x0,L0,L1,R,G,σ,v,ε,δ, are public; F,X,x*,g and their probability law are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapNoiseConstrainedGeneralizedMonotone.lean: Params, IsGapStochasticOperator.variance, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.admissible

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The successful output must belong to X jointly with satisfying the residual criterion.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Joint feasibility and residual accuracy hold with probability at least 1−δ, for ε > 0 and 0 < δ < 1, under the combined algorithm and oracle randomness. Both oracle budgets are fixed caps.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapNoiseConstrainedGeneralizedMonotone.lean: spec.valid and spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and executeWithTrace

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: A measurable output x must admit ξ ∈ N_X(x) with ‖F(x)+ξ‖ ≤ ε. This is an unsquared normal-cone residual criterion, not a variational gap or an unconstrained operator norm criterion.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The constrained monotone VI combines operator-norm-dependent generalized smoothness, gap-dependent stochastic variance, and a high-probability normal-cone residual requirement under separately counted projection and sampling budgets.

descriptionHtml:
Constrained Monotone Operators with Gap Noise

We consider a variational inequality for a continuous monotone operator F:E→E on a convex set X in a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E. The operator satisfies a generalized Lipschitz bound, and a given point x0∈X lies near a solution. Two oracles return independent-sample unbiased estimates of F on X, with variance controlled by an operator gap, and exact projections onto X. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯∈X admitting u∈E with ⟨u,w−x¯⟩≤0 for every w∈X and ∥F(x¯)+u∥≤ε, with probability at least 1−δ.

The underlying variational inequality is to find x⋆∈X such that ⟨F(x⋆),w−x⋆⟩≥0for every w∈X. The norm is induced by the inner product on E. The parameters satisfy L0>0,L1≥0,R>0,G,σ,v≥0. The algorithm receives E, a measurable sample space Ω, x0, and all parameters L0,L1,R,G,σ,v,ε,δ; it accesses F and X through the two oracles.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Feasibility and reference solution). The set X⊆E is convex and contains x0. There exists a solution x⋆ of the variational inequality satisfying ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,∥F(x⋆)∥≤G. An exact projection map ΠX:E→E is available and satisfies, for every z∈E, ΠX(z)∈X,⟨z−ΠX(z),w−ΠX(z)⟩≤0for every w∈X.

Assumption 2 (Monotonicity and generalized Lipschitz bound). The operator F is continuous on E, and for all x,y∈E, ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0. For every x,y∈E and M∈R, the segment bound ∥F(x+θ(y−x))∥≤Mfor every θ∈[0,1] implies ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Gap-dependent stochastic noise). There is a probability measure ν on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈X, the random vector g(x,Z) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,Z)−F(x)∥2 is integrable for Z∼ν, with EZ∼ν[g(x,Z)]=F(x),EZ∼ν[∥g(x,Z)−F(x)∥2]≤σ2+v⟨F(x)−F(x⋆),x−x⋆⟩. The reference solution x⋆ is the same as above. The oracle samples (Zk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law ν. This sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness.

Both oracles accept queries in E. At the kth oracle call, a stochastic query at x returns g(x,Zk), whereas a projection query at z returns ΠX(z). The stochastic moment conditions apply to queries in X. Stochastic-operator calls and projection calls are counted separately.

Define the normal cone at x∈X by NX(x)={u∈E:⟨u,w−x⟩≤0 for every w∈X}. After the allotted calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy P(¬[x¯∈X and ∃u∈NX(x¯):∥F(x¯)+u∥≤ε])≤δ, where P is the joint law of the oracle samples and the independent algorithm randomness.

comparisonHtml:
In a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, X is convex with exact projection, x0∈X, and F is continuous and monotone on the whole space. For every segment [x,y], ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥F(z)∥)∥x−y∥. A VI solution x⋆∈X satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and ∥F(x⋆)∥≤G. The jointly measurable, integrable IID oracle is unbiased on X, with integrable squared error bounded in expectation by σ2+v⟨F(x)−F(x⋆),x−x⋆⟩. Here L0,R,ε>0, L1,G,σ,v≥0, and 0<δ<1. Target: under the IID sampling law P, with probability at least 1−δ, the measurable output lies in X and admits ξ∈NX(x) with ∥F(x)+ξ∥≤ε.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMonotone
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Basic

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.GapNoiseConstrainedGeneralizedMonotone

open OracleTemplate

structure Params extends StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.Params.{0} where
  G : ℝ
  v : ℝ

structure Instance (q : Params) where
  F : q.E → q.E
  X : Set q.E

structure IsGapStochasticOperator {E Ω : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (p : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure p] (X : Set E) (F : E → E)
    (g : E → Ω → E) (xstar : E) (σ v : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x ∈ X, Integrable (g x) p
  unbiased : ∀ x ∈ X, (∫ ω, g x ω ∂p) = F x
  variance_integrable : ∀ x ∈ X, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2) p
  variance : ∀ x ∈ X, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2 ∂p) ≤
    σ ^ 2 + v * ⟪F x - F xstar, x - xstar⟫

abbrev spec : Setup where
  numOracles := 2
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query q := q.E
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 ≤ q.v ∧
    0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)) (proj : q.E → q.E),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (i, x) seed => if i = 0 then g x seed else proj x } ∧
    (∀ z, proj z ∈ I.X ∧ ∀ w ∈ I.X, ⟪z - proj z, w - proj z⟫ ≤ 0) ∧
    Convex ℝ I.X ∧ q.x0 ∈ I.X ∧ Continuous I.F ∧
    (∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪I.F x - I.F y, x - y⟫) ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.F (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.F x - I.F y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.X, (∀ w ∈ I.X, 0 ≤ ⟪I.F xstar, w - xstar⟫) ∧
      ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧ ‖I.F xstar‖ ≤ q.G ∧
      IsGapStochasticOperator (p : Measure _) I.X I.F g xstar q.σ q.v)
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ (P : Measure _) {ω | ¬(output ω ∈ I.X ∧
      ∃ ξ : q.E, (∀ w ∈ I.X, ⟪ξ, w - output ω⟫ ≤ 0) ∧ ‖I.F (output ω) + ξ‖ ≤ q.ε)} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.GapNoiseConstrainedGeneralizedMonotone
